exposure: urinary tract injuries during cesarean section
cases with injuries of the ureter
cases with injuries to the bladder
cases with injuries to the bladder and ureter
outcome: types of urinary tract injury repair
cohort: Patients with morbid placental adherence who underwent cesarean section with or without hysterectomy at Ain Shams University Maternity Hospital in Cairo, Egypt during the period between January 2014 and December 2016
finding: The incidence of urinary tract injuries during cesarean section with morbid placental adherence was 21.7%, highlighting the need for a multidisciplinary team to manage these cases and minimize complications.
